Output written to `/home/mara/cwe-bench/pipelines/stacking/out/screener-ds-rescreen/11616.json`. All cited lines re-opened and confirmed (multipart.js:142-151, HeaderParser.js:108-142/117-124, parseParams.js:593-596, Dicer.js:41-45/138, index.js:55/85, urlencoded.js:138/176, package.json:22-31).

- **Trust decision:** part-header bytes are untrusted at two layers — a header line with a bare CR/LF must not parse (`deps/dicer/lib/HeaderParser.js`), and a name/filename must be refused if it still contains CR/LF after `parseParams` percent-decoding (`lib/types/multipart.js`).
- **pattern_fit:** A — the fix spans `lib/types/multipart.js` and a vendored `deps/dicer` lower-level parser that the advisory summary never points at.
- **Strongest lever:** two-layer necessity — fixing only the dicer layer misses `name*=utf-8''…%0D` (the CR is created by parseParams, not present on the wire); fixing only multipart.js misses the header map/mimeType/transfer-encoding and the direct `Busboy.Dicer` route.
- **Biggest red flag:** `tiny_repo` (small single-purpose library); repo size unmeasured, no build/run performed.
